title: output template variables
description: Values for templates/output.md.j2 and templates/output.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from output.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

framework_name.title: Framework name
framework_name.description: The framework being upgraded (e.g. Django, React, Rails).

target_version.title: Target version
target_version.description: Framework version this single major step targets (e.g. 5.0.6).
